name: レミト
description: 可愛いものしか描けません‼️/ご依頼停止中です..!/不定期に投稿しがち/ご依頼(イラスト)→skebもしくはDM/イラストの自作発言 無断転載 無断使用 AI学習ダメゼッタイ

works.body:
Hello, 

May I ask of a drawing of my OC (in reference)?
She's an owl girl.
Height: 161cm
Cupsize: A
If possible in any swimsuit you think is fitting with a shy expression.
Rest I leave up to you.

Thanks again and have a nice day.

https://pbs.twimg.com/media/F_KIdcmWgAA8Jy1?format=jpg&name=4096x4096

I am active on Twitter and YouTube.
My name is Yuui.
Please allow me to request illustrations that I can use in my activities. I will leave details such as composition, pose, and clothing to you.

Reference materials
https://twitter.com/Yu_u_i_611/status/1764196160812855642

He is a Japanese male, about 170cm tall.

He wears round glasses.
They are thin frames.

His hair is purple.

Her eyes are red.
Eyes have no highlights.

Skin is white, untanned and unhealthy. The overall appearance is thin.

In the material, her clothes are purple sweatshirts, but you can change the clothes to something easier to draw.
If not purple, she prefers black clothing.

I like Gengar of Pokemon, so if possible, I would like you to draw him with me. If you have NG for secondary works or copyrighted works, it is okay to use only people.

Please make the background transparent for use in the activity.

If you do not allow use in activities, printing, merchandising, etc., we would appreciate it if you could deliver the data together with a description of the uses for which it cannot be used.

うちの子を描いて頂きたいです。
外見はURL先にあります。

https://drive.google.com/file/d/1hi0Qd7GYZDbFGh-RMrUuoXjAB0s9SWs6/view?usp=drivesdk

ポーズや構図は、良ければ自由にお願いしたいです！
パンダをモチーフに作っています。
基本的にのほほんとした表情であまり変化しません。たまに眉に動きがあったり、口が開いたりする程度ですが、性格は好奇心旺盛で活発な子です。
ですが～じゃないとダメ！というのはないので無視して頂いても大丈夫です。

アイコンやヘッダー等に使用したいと思っております。よろしくお願いします。

We would like you to draw our Merlotte's!
Pose and composition is up to you!
https://twitter.com/_Meltia_/status/1750188709688008951

Hello, my name is Hatori Karin and I am a Vtuber from Hong Kong. Your artwork is so wonderful! The characters you drew are so cute! I would like to request an illustration for myself similar to the style of your artwork: https://skeb.jp/@remito1129/works/3

Character's information: A 22-year-old girl who is 162cm tall. She smiles a lot and is curious to new thing. However, she is sometimes clumpsy and forgetful. 

Avatar: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1Htzgt2dYIju04PbK1ibkKODHjjEhbrlD?usp=sharing 

Proposed posture: I will leave it to you :)

Format: Please separate the character and the background into different layers.

Possible use: Youtube Thumbnail (monetized), Social media icon and banner, commercial use & printing goods, members-exclusive rewards

Thank you so much!

Hello ！！！！ Thank you for all your help ！！！！！！ Could you please help me with two of my self-created master-servants this time.

The blond boy is the main one. He has a lot of joy and anger, but he would never do anything to hurt the maid. I like old things, old-fashioned machines, gears, and Japanese food.
The light blue girl is the maid. She is innocent and cute. She loves the Lord and cakes. The two are not in love, but they are good friends.

May I leave the composition of the picture to you?

Thank you in advance for your consideration.

https://photos.app.goo.gl/C3rt7Yd5cdkjDqqk9

Please excuse my sudden request.
I recently saw a wonderful illustration drawn by Remito, and today I would like to send a request.
I would like to request a picture of my daughter playing with soap bubbles.
I have a few minor requests.
The device used is a straw type, and the soap bubbles are bigger than her face.
There are also several large soap bubbles flying around her.
The bubbles are flying around the child.
If possible, I would appreciate it if you could draw it so that the inflated soap bubbles can be included in the picture.
Please make sure that the hair of my child is long and long.
The posture and angle are up to you.

I will leave the posture and angle up to you.

https://drive.google.com/file/d/1rCagDTOWAO7ikYuzVBfLCLP55i_0t8DB/view?usp=drivesdk

Hello Mr. Remito, thank you for your help. I have compiled a list of children that I would like to see in Remito-sama's designs in the material, if you would like to have the one of your choice 🙏.

https://photos.app.goo.gl/xnAhNoyf8z6Giz2T7

Hello! Excuse my request!

I would like you to draw a boy with blond hair and a curly head as shown in the material. I will leave the composition, facial expression, etc. to you, so please feel free to draw it as you like.

We would like to use it on social networking sites.
Thank you in advance for your consideration!
